Follow channelNo account override; hosted injection for non-Lite requests follows the channel or global policy, while client-provided hosted tools and local image_gen declarations pass through.
Enable hosted bridgeInject the hosted image_generation tool only for non-Responses Lite requests; client-provided image tools still pass through.
No hosted injectionDo not inject the hosted tool; client-provided hosted tools and local image_gen declarations still pass through.

Strip client image toolsDo not auto-inject through the bridge, and remove client-provided hosted image_generation tools, local image_gen declarations, and matching tool_choice. Image-only model routing remains unaffected.
